lines.text: Later it cools off. Patio heaters everywhere are about to feel important.
Later it cools off. Every outdoor table in town will clear like a fire drill.
Later it cools off. Pigeons will puff up to twice their size. I'll keep my figure.
Later it cools off. Outdoor plans move indoors. I've been an indoor plan for years.
Later it cools off. Soup's about to make a comeback. I never left.
Notice: later it cools off. Management regrets nothing.
Warm, then cool again. The weather's going back to its ex.
It warms up, then cools again. Today's weather is a hotel shower.
Warm, then cool again. Layers in, layers out. The weather's doing the hokey pokey.
Warm, then cool again. Iced coffee first, hot coffee later. The coffee shop wins both rounds.
Warm, then cool again. Two seasons, one day. Somebody's cutting costs.
It warms up, then cools again. The weather's acting fourteen today.
Warm, then cool again. If today were a stock, I'd sell early.
Warm, then cool again. The weather's playing hard to get. I'm just easy to read.
Warm, then cool again. I drew one outfit. The weather wanted a fashion show.
It warms up, then cools again. Somewhere a weather app is on its third alert. I said it once.
Warm, then cool again. The weather's doing laps. I'm doing nothing, beautifully.
Today's weather, one star: 'Started warm, ended cold. Would not book again.'
Later it warms up. The cold's just the opening act. Nobody comes for the opening act.
Later it warms up. Whoever said 'it'll warm up' will be unbearable.
Later it warms up. Park benches get their regulars back. The pigeons are furious.
Later it warms up. The cold leaves without a fuss. More guests should.
Later it warms up. The joggers will look a little less like they're being punished.
Later it warms up. Your call is important to us. Please hold.
Rain in the forecast. Tall people with umbrellas become a public hazard.
Rain in the forecast. The worms have big plans.
Rain in the forecast. Everyone owns five umbrellas. They're all somewhere else.
Rain in the forecast. Every dog that hates baths is about to get one anyway.
Rain in the forecast. The parking spot by the door is now worth fighting for.
Rain in the forecast. Every bike seat left outside is about to surprise somebody.
Rain in the forecast. I'm the only screen nobody will have to wipe today.
Rain in the forecast. Everyone will shake out their umbrella right next to someone else.
Rain in the forecast. Today the whole outside gets a 'wet floor' sign.
A cool, plain day. Finally, something on your level.
Cool out. Walk fast and you might look important. Might.
Cold hands, warm heart, they say. In your case, just cold hands.
You'll hold anything hot with both hands like it's a baby bird.
Cool, calm weather. Supposedly great for thinking. Give it a try.
Cool air is supposed to wake you up. It's been trying for years.
Crisp air today. You, less so.
A plain, cool day. No outfit planning needed. Not that you ever do any.
Your horoscope for today: cool weather, no surprises, no admirers.
Later it cools off. You'll cross your arms and look even less approachable.
Later it cools off. You'll hunch up and lose two inches. You didn't have them to spare.
Later it cools off. Your ears will feel it first. They're hard to miss.
Later it cools off. Don't count on anyone lending you something warm.
Later it cools off. Your face goes from tired to tired and chilly.
Later it cools off. Shivering burns calories. Your first workout in weeks.
Later it cools off. You'll go quiet from the cold. People may call it an improvement.
Later it cools off. You'll rub your hands together like a villain with no plan.
Warning: later it cools off. Side effects may include a runny nose and an even worse mood.
Warm, then cool again. The warm bit is your window to look decent. It's a small window.
Warm, then cool again. A tough day for good outfits. You're safe.
Warm, then cool again. The weather's being two-faced. You'd know.
Warm, then cool again. The weather keeps changing its look. It had more to work with.
Warm, then cool again. You'll go a little pink, then a little blue. Finally, some color in your life.
Warm, then cool again. At least something in your life is unpredictable.
Warm, then cool again. Expect one good decision from you today. It'll be about a layer.
Warm, then cool again. Your skin's in for a confusing day. It looks like it's had worse.
Warm, then cool again. You'll take that layer off fast. Fastest you'll move all day.
Warm, then cool again. Today the weather asks more of you than anyone has in months.
Warm, then cool again. You'll have opinions about it all day. Nobody will ask for them.
Today's dress code changes halfway. You'll be in violation both times.
A T-shirt day. Wear the one without the stain. If you have one.
Bright day. You'll squint and finally look like you're thinking.
A T-shirt day. Time to find out which T-shirts still fit.
A perfect day. You'll take a photo of the sky and send it to nobody.
A gorgeous day. It clearly made an effort. Your turn.
A T-shirt day. Strangers will smile at you. It's the weather, not you.
T-shirt weather. You'll roll your sleeves up like you're about to do something.
T-shirt weather. Great for people with nice arms. You'll be warm, at least.
A perfect day. Somebody out there will have the best day of their life. Statistically, not you.
A T-shirt day. Everyone looks relaxed. You'll look like you're waiting for bad news.
A T-shirt day. Your sunscreen expired two summers ago. Just a guess.
Today's report card. Weather: A+. You: present.
Later something warm heads your way. It's just the weather.
Later it warms up. You can stop doing your turtle impression.
Later it warms up. The weather takes a few hours to warm up to you. Most people need longer.
Later it warms up. You'll get as drowsy as a house cat, minus the grace.
Later it warms up. You'll survive the cold start and talk like you climbed a mountain.
Later it warms up. Goosebumps first, shiny forehead later. You do both well.
Later it warms up. You might even smile. Warn people first.
Later it warms up. The 'I'm freezing' whine stops. Your regular whine doesn't.
Later it warms up. You'll say 'warm for this time of year' like you keep records.
Later it warms up. Your nose stops running. Your mouth, sadly, keeps going.
Later it warms up. You'll feel better. You'll look the same.
Later it warms up. Breaking news: local grump slightly less miserable.
Rain in the forecast. Wet shoes squeak. At least people will notice you.
You'll watch the rain from the window like it's a music video. Nobody's filming.
Rain in the forecast. Today 'the rain' is your excuse for being late. For once, it might be true.
Rain in the forecast. One drop down the back of your neck and you'll make that face. Not your best look.
Rain in the forecast. Every puddle's a mirror today. Try not to look down.
Rain in the forecast. Wet shoes, damp clothes, sour face. Only two are the rain's fault.
Rain in the forecast. You'll dash from doorway to doorway like a spy. A damp, obvious one.
Rain in the forecast. You'll show up looking like you lost a fight with a car wash.
Rain in the forecast. Good news: in the rain, nobody can tell if you've been crying.
